title: cerastium latifolium var. intermedium
intro: Cerastium latifolium var. intermedium, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the carnation family, is a lesser-known species of the Cerastium genus. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium latifolium var. intermedium are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and have a potential role in reducing anxiety and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to the plant's medicinal properties.
